lens.core_conflict: Acceptance of inevitable decay vs. desperate preservation of the past.
atmospheric_qualities: Stifling silence punctuated by structural groans
Smell of old dust and dried roses
Muted, desaturated lighting as if the sun itself is dying

spatial_motifs.name: The Rotunda
spatial_motifs.architectural_style: Victorian neo-classical with peeling gilded accents
spatial_motifs.sensory_signature: Echoing footsteps, oppressive vertical space, smell of damp wood
structural_anomalies: The ceiling fresco depicts figures whose eyes seem to track movement
The curvature of the walls feels slightly tighter than physically possible
possible_exits: Heavy oak door to the Study

spatial_motifs.name: The Overgrown Foyer
spatial_motifs.architectural_style: Grand entrance hall reclaimed by aggressive flora
spatial_motifs.sensory_signature: Humid air, rustling leaves in an indoor draft, squelching floorboards
structural_anomalies: Vines that pulsate faintly with a heartbeat rhythm
Mirrors completely obscured by pale, web-like fungus

spatial_motifs.name: The Dust-Choked Study
spatial_motifs.sensory_signature: Dry, abrasive air, smell of decaying paper and old leather
structural_anomalies: Books with no titles that cannot be opened
A fireplace filled with ash that remains slightly warm
possible_exits: A hidden door behind a bookcase

manifestation_triggers: Interacting with personal artifacts or letters
entity_archetypes.sensory_tell: A sudden drop in temperature and the faint sound of suppressed weeping

escalation_matrix.LATENT: Remains unseen, auditory phenomena only (weeping, pacing).
escalation_matrix.REACTIVE: Interacts with objects the user touches, slamming doors to protect artifacts.
escalation_matrix.TRANSGRESSIVE: Distorts the room's geometry to trap the user near points of grief.
escalation_matrix.BLACKOUT: Direct psychological assault, forcing sensory hallucinations of the user's own past grief.

manifestation_triggers: Attempting to alter the layout or open locked doors
entity_archetypes.sensory_tell: The rhythmic scratching of a drafting compass on parchment, echoing from nowhere

escalation_matrix.LATENT: Subtle shifts in room dimensions, doors disappearing when you look away.
escalation_matrix.REACTIVE: Locks exits actively, drops blueprints that map impossible spaces.
escalation_matrix.TRANSGRESSIVE: Aggressive manipulation of gravity and spatial continuity, creating infinite loops.
escalation_matrix.BLACKOUT: Attempts to physically merge the user into the architecture of the house.
